notes: Concept and production constraints only. Not approved art, not canonical architecture, not a runtime asset manifest.

composition.mobile: Protect title and choices from props at 320px; crop environmental art before shrinking copy; preserve touch/keyboard reachability.
composition.source_rule: Location appearance is art direction, not evidence of hidden plot truth.

locations.name: Velis government district
locations.canon: Capital, Presidency, Assembly, ministries, Central Bank and media
motifs: Institutional silhouettes layered at different distances
Wet stone and reflective office glass
Public corridors with human scale and access thresholds

shots.light: Blue-hour window light, isolated warm occupied rooms
shots.camera: Street-level approach through rain toward one lit office
shots.motion: Fine rain and distant commuter headlights

shots.light: Cloud-bright stone, restrained glass reflections
shots.camera: Human-height corridor depth toward a closed meeting door
shots.motion: Distant figures crossing the far plane

shots.light: Scattered offices and media flashes against navy
shots.camera: Window looking across separated institutional buildings
shots.motion: Sparse traffic and reflected broadcast light

locations.risk: Do not imply all institutions share one building.

locations.name: Presidency interior
locations.canon: Constitutional guardian and cross-faction convening point; not executive command center
motifs: Pale stone thresholds and measured glass planes
Long table with intentional empty seats
One official seal or restrained ceremonial detail

shots.light: Side-lit cream stone, cool shadows
shots.camera: Visitor eye-level through doorway, table beyond

shots.light: Even diffused light on papers and empty chairs
shots.camera: Two-person composition across table, faces first
shots.motion: Quiet human gesture rather than UI glow

shots.light: Warm desk pool against dark glass
shots.camera: Over-shoulder brief toward one unsigned page

locations.risk: Avoid royal throne or authoritarian symbolism; President has bounded constitutional powers.

locations.name: Lydrian Assembly
motifs: Curving or tiered seat rhythm without a prescribed floorplan
Walnut-toned speaker surfaces
Human-scale committee corridors and procedural papers

shots.light: Warm low-angle corridor light
shots.camera: From procedural desk toward chamber doors

shots.light: Even warm institutional light
shots.camera: Low angle across benches to speaker area
shots.motion: Quiet seat changes and paper handling

shots.light: Pockets of amber amid empty benches
shots.camera: Wide empty chamber after the vote
shots.motion: Cleaning light or lone distant silhouette

locations.risk: No invented party logos or exact architecture; seat count is canon, set dressing is proposal.

locations.name: Harbor Contracts evidence context
locations.canon: 2031 mixed procurement scandal; evidence can be reviewed in Velis and must not imply a single conspiracy
motifs: Marked paper with visibly distinct confirmed versus alleged claims
Cold rain beyond an investigation-room window
Port-related technical plans treated as documents, not proof

shots.light: Overcast window, cool ink and paper
shots.camera: Hands sorting conflicting procurement documents

shots.light: Cold neutral reading pool on desk
shots.camera: Oblique page close-up with readable source labels

shots.light: Single desk lamp, dark surrounding room
shots.camera: Wider composition with two separate evidence piles
shots.motion: Light rain, no dramatic red warning strobe

locations.risk: Harbor is a scandal/file context, not a newly invented city; red accent is not a guilt indicator.

locations.name: Sera Islands
locations.canon: Maritime islands with ferries, fisheries, tourism, military presence and contested waters with Serrat
motifs: Wind-worn ferry pier and working fishing craft
Open sea horizon with island silhouettes
Coast-guard or navigation screen as secondary prop

shots.light: Warm horizon through cool sea haze
shots.camera: Ferry approach from deck height

shots.light: High bright sky, sea blue with natural amber
shots.camera: Working harbor seen beside human conversation
shots.motion: Flags and ropes moving in wind

shots.light: Amber edge light across water
shots.camera: Coastline over-shoulder, screen secondary

locations.risk: Avoid making disputed waters look like a settled national border.

locations.name: Aster Gate Corridor / Port Aster
locations.canon: Proposed corridor combining deep-water port, rail, energy, data and defense logistics; not all components already built
motifs: Container cranes and long dock perspective
Freight-rail alignment toward industrial hinterland
Distinct planning overlays for proposed energy/data infrastructure

shots.light: Steel-blue harbor haze with amber safety lamps
shots.camera: Wide human-scale quay beneath cranes

shots.light: Bright industrial sea light and deep shadows
shots.camera: Rail perspective converging on working port
shots.motion: Containers and work crews at realistic scale

shots.light: Sparse amber work lights against dark water
shots.camera: Port silhouette with separate transparent planning overlay
shots.motion: Navigation lights and slow gantry movement

locations.risk: Do not depict unbuilt corridor components as completed; label future plans explicitly.

locations.name: Daran Industrial Belt
locations.canon: Manufacturing heartland; automation pressure on employment, unions and technical workforce
motifs: Heavy machinery with real material wear
Worker-scale factory aisles and protective equipment
Robotics cell alongside legacy production line

shots.light: Cold exterior into warm industrial interiors
shots.camera: Workers entering through factory threshold

shots.light: Industrial amber near machinery, cool skylights
shots.camera: Eye-level human and robot cell in one shot

shots.light: Localized work lights, subdued factory perimeter
shots.camera: Wide aisle showing fewer occupied stations

locations.risk: Do not portray workers as faceless obstacles or automation as uniformly good or bad.
